chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī narrated from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, who said:
One of his companions wrote to him, peace be upon him, saying: "I had a wife, and I have a child from her, and I let her go."
So he, peace be upon him, wrote: "The woman has more right to the child until he reaches seven years of age, unless the woman chooses otherwise."

key_terms.أَحَقُّ: more entitled or having a stronger legal right
key_terms.امْرَأَةٌ: a wife or woman, here referring to the child's mother
key_terms.خَلَّيْتُ سَبِيلَهَا: I released her or let her go, meaning separation or divorce
key_terms.وَلَدٌ: a child born from the marriage

ai.seo_question: Who has more right to custody of a child after divorce according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning custody of a young child after separation between the parents. It states that the mother has the stronger right to the child until the age of seven, unless she willingly relinquishes that right.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4504 - Abdullah ibn Jafar al-Himyari narrated from Ayyub ibn Nuh, who said:
One of his (as) companions wrote to him, saying: "I had a wife, and I have a child from her, but I divorced her."
Imam (as) wrote in reply: "The mother has more right to the child until the child reaches seven years of age, unless the mother chooses otherwise."
